metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Bryce Canyon National Park appear lower compared to Las Vegas during 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG) - Date range: 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31 - Two locations: Bryce Canyon National Park (Utah) and Las Vegas (Nevada) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for nighttime lights - Use the 'avg_rad' band which is the average radiance 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero is expected for Bryce Canyon (dark sky park) - Check collection size first (C1) - Check pixel count after processing (C2) - Verify results are not None/NaN (C3) - Compare: if Bryce Canyon < Las Vegas, answer A (Yes, Bryce is lower) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const bryceCanyon = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.1826, 37.5930]); // Bryce Canyon NP const lasVegas = ee.Geometry.Point([-115.1398, 36.1699]); // Las Vegas const startDate = '2024-01-01'; const endDate = '2024-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const nightlights = ee.ImageCollection('VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('avg_rad'); const bryceCol = nightlights.filterBounds(bryceCanyon); const vegasCol = nightlights.filterBounds(lasVegas); const bryceSize = bryceCol.size().getInfo(); const vegasSize = vegasCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Bryce Canyon images: ${bryceSize}`); console.log(`Las Vegas images: ${vegasSize}`); if (bryceSize === 0 || vegasSize === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both locations."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean nighttime light intensity const bryceMean = bryceCol.mean(); const vegasMean = vegasCol.mean(); // 4. Calculate statistics const bryceStats = bryceMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: bryceCanyon.buffer(5000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const vegasStats = vegasMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: lasVegas.buffer(5000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const bryceValue = bryceStats['avg_rad_mean']; const bryceCount = bryceStats['avg_rad_count']; const vegasValue = vegasStats['avg_rad_mean']; const vegasCount = vegasStats['avg_rad_count']; console.log(`Bryce Canyon: Mean=${bryceValue}, Pixels=${bryceCount}`); console.log(`Las Vegas: Mean=${vegasValue}, Pixels=${vegasCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (bryceCount === 0 || vegasCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (bryceValue === null || bryceValue === undefined || vegasValue === null || vegasValue === undefined || isNaN(bryceValue) || isNaN(vegasValue)) { console.log("Calculation failure - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Bryce/Vegas ratio: ${(bryceValue/vegasValue).toFixed(4)}`); if (bryceValue < vegasValue) { console.log("Bryce Canyon is darker than Las Vegas."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Bryce Canyon is not darker than Las Vegas."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
